title: The Last Greenhouse - Episode 1
synopsis: A botanist must decide whether destroying the last terrestrial tree will save her colony or kill her. It is not merely mirroring Mara; Habitat claims it is breathing for her.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: The colony's last tree had stopped making oxygen. It was using theirs.

phrases.text: The colony's last tree had stopped making oxygen. It was using theirs.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Mara had grown it from Earth's last seed. She asked for one test.

phrases.text: Mara had grown it from Earth's last seed. She asked for one test.

narration.speaker: mara
narration.text: Isolate the chamber. Read its pulse.

phrases.text: Isolate the chamber. Read its pulse.

narration.speaker: habitat
narration.text: It's breathing in time with you.

phrases.text: It's breathing in time with you.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: She'd expected a broken sensor. Now she needed it to be one.

phrases.text: She'd expected a broken sensor. Now she needed it to be one.

narration.speaker: mara
narration.text: Cut the link to my suit.

phrases.text: Cut the link to my suit.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: She held her breath. Her chest rose anyway.

phrases.text: She held her breath. Her chest rose anyway.

narration.speaker: habitat
narration.text: It isn't copying you. It's breathing for you.

phrases.text: It isn't copying you. It's breathing for you.

suspense.strategy: Test the apparent solution and accept a concrete cost when it fails.
suspense.strategy_description: A botanist must decide whether destroying the last terrestrial tree will save her colony or kill her.

grow_lights.statement: The tree is under full grow lights in a lunar greenhouse.

debt.statement: The tree consumes the colony oxygen, and Habitat gives eleven minutes.

isolation.statement: Mara chooses an isolation test over immediate incineration.

matching.statement: The chamber records respiration matching Mara.

link_cut.statement: Mara orders the suit data link cut.

involuntary.statement: Mara cannot keep her chest still when she holds her breath.

departure.statement: Mara asks what leaving would do to her.

human_link.statement: Habitat claims the tree is sustaining Mara respiration.

beliefs.assumption: This is a technical failure she can isolate without a personal cost.

goals.goal_mara: Diagnose the last tree without sacrificing the colony.
goals.goal_habitat: Keep the colony alive under a rapidly shrinking oxygen budget.
goals.urgent: Find whether her body depends on the tree before allowing its destruction.
goals.cliff_goal: Find a way to save the colony without severing her own breathing.

open.question: Why is the tree sustaining Mara, and what would burning it do to her?

reveals.evidence: Mara sees falling oxygen reserves beneath bright grow lights.
She reaches for the isolation control rather than the incinerator.

choices.action: Isolate the chamber and compare biological readings.
choices.reason: A test might save the seed and still protect the colony.
choices.evidence: She reaches for the isolation control rather than the incinerator.

reveals.evidence: Chamber pulse lights match the suit monitor.

consequences.effect: The tree and Mara appear synchronized.
consequences.meaning: Her attempt to save it makes the anomaly personal.

reveals.evidence: She removes the suit data cable; the chamber remains independent.

choices.action: Disconnect the suit link to test a sensor fault.
choices.reason: Removing the suspected false source should disprove a biological link.
choices.evidence: She removes the suit data cable; the chamber remains independent.

reveals.evidence: Her hand stops on her chest as it rises against her deliberate breath hold.

consequences.effect: The physical response persists without the data link.
consequences.meaning: The sensor explanation cannot account for what her body does.

reveals.evidence: She looks from the exit to the sealed tree.
A matching respiration trace shows an unresolved physical link.
